title: Pleasant Sailing Day
text: We had a fantastic private sailing day with Captain Victor. He was friendly, engaging, and made the whole trip feel easy and relaxing.
author: Kendall_C

title: Definitely recommend
text: Nico was wondering and so kind. He played us Jazz in his speaker and it was so peaceful. You will not be disappointed by this excursion especially if you get Niko. He gave us facts about the area, answered any questions we had, and was so pleasant to talk with during our trip.
author: Haley H

title: A wonderful time!
text: We had a great time on the tour! Captain Nico was very accommodating for our first time on a sailboat. The views of the city were amazing. Didn’t quite get to see the sunset since the sun didn’t go down until 9:30pm, but that was out of our hands.
author: Matt_D

title: Excellent
text: I have organized this romantic tour to celebrate our anniversary! There is nothing more romantic than watching a sunset from the sea. It was an unforgettable experience. Skipper Rafa made us very comfortable and we were even able to take the helm and sail. Quite a hit. We'll be back!
author: primobernie

title: Best anniversay ever
text: We had such a wonderful time, the sailing boat was very well prepared, the skipper made us feel special. The sunset was incredible. Overall what a great surprise for our special anniversary.
author: Davidisun

title: Beautiful and perfect way to end our...
text: Beautiful and perfect way to end our time in Barcelona!!
author: Michelle S

title: Absolutely amazing.  One of the best...
text: Absolutely amazing. One of the best trips and was the perfect ending to our Holiday. Thank you Viator
author: Cheryl_B

title: The private sunset sail was very...
text: The private sunset sail was very enjoyable! Our skipper was great and helped out taking photos for us a few times which was very nice. We were very lucky as midway through our sail we were able to see a few schools of dolphins around the boat which was a nice surprise! The tour included a bottle of cava and we brought an extra just in case that they stored for us in a fridge to keep cold for the beginning of the trip which was great. Would recommend this tour to anyone looking for a relaxing evening before dinner in Barcelona.
author: Steven M

title: This trip was perfect. I brought...
text: This trip was perfect. I brought this as a surprise present for my girlfriend and it was just, perfect! The skipper was very friendly, helpful and had a lot of local knowledge on the area. He made my girlfriend feel safe even though she was a little scared. Ive been on hundreds of sailing trips now and this one was defiantly one of the best. Next time I'm in Barcelona i will be sure to book this again. Only advice is, if you take your own champagne make sure its cold because there is no fridge on board. Highly recommend from an experienced traveler. A
author: marc w

title: Superb tho a little choppy that day...
text: Superb tho a little choppy that day. Rob was fantastic skipper. And my partner now wants to take up sailing! (His first time on a boat!)
author: vivienne w
